site.name: FarsiYab
site.tagline: Find Iranian and Persian-speaking businesses in your city
site.description: FarsiYab finds Iranian and Persian-speaking businesses outside Iran from open sources and shows where each result came from and why.

form.needCity: Choose a country and a city

results.title: {categories} in {city}
results.none: No results for this search yet.

results.registriesHint: These official directories let you filter by spoken language. We only link to them; their data is not copied into FarsiYab.
results.lastIndexed: Data for this city last updated: {date}
results.neverIndexed: This city has not been searched yet.
results.error: Could not reach the server. Please try again in a moment.
results.suggest: Know a business that is missing? Add it

footer.disclaimer: FarsiYab collects results automatically from public sources; they may be wrong or out of date. Every result shows its sources and why it is listed.
footer.attribution: Data © OpenStreetMap contributors and Overture Maps Foundation

submit.title: Add a business
submit.intro: Know an Iranian or Persian-speaking business that FarsiYab is missing? Tell us about it. It will be shown after we review it.
submit.name: Business name
submit.nameHint: As on its sign or page, in Persian or Latin script
submit.addressHint: Leave empty for online or home-based businesses
submit.linksHint: At least one: website, Instagram, Facebook or a Google Maps page. This link is the evidence shown to users.
submit.emailHint: Only to ask about this submission; never shown.
submit.consent: Once approved, the details above are shown publicly. Please do not enter personal information such as the owner's name.
submit.sent: Thank you! We received it and will show it after review.
submit.failed: Could not send. Please try again.
submit.tooMany: You have reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow.
submit.invalid: Some details are not valid. Links must start with https://.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.hint: The FARSIYAB_ADMIN_TOKEN value on the server.
login.disabled: The admin panel is off: FARSIYAB_ADMIN_TOKEN is not set on the server.

reports.removeHint: "Remove for good" puts the business's links on the do-not-index list so no source brings it back.

labels.hint: Is this business really Iranian or Persian-speaking? Judge from the evidence and links; open them when unsure.
labels.done: Everything in this filter is labeled.
labels.goal: Phase 4 goal: precision of at least {goal} for "high" and "medium", with {target} samples per level

claims.sendLink: Send this link to the owner (shown only once):
claims.manualHint: Verify manual claims only after calling the business's public number or another reliable check. Website and Telegram claims are verified by the owners themselves.

map.failed: The map could not be loaded.
map.none: None of these results has a known location.
map.count: {count} results on the map (results without a location are not shown)

seo.cityIntro: Restaurants, doctors, lawyers, shops and other businesses in {city} that FarsiYab found in public sources. Every result shows its source and why it is listed as Iranian.
seo.categoryDescription: {count} Iranian and Persian-speaking {category} in {city}, with the source and evidence for each result.
seo.empty: No results in this category yet.

claim.title: Manage your business
claim.intro: If you own this business you can correct its address, phone and website, or mark it closed, without creating an account. First show us that the business is yours.

methods.website: Put a code on the business's website
methods.telegram: Put a code in the business's Telegram channel description
methods.manual: Checked by us by hand (e.g. a call to the business's public number)

claim.emailHint: Only for this request; required for manual checks.
claim.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
claim.noLink: We have no such link for this business. Please choose another method.
claim.putToken: Put this code on {where} (anywhere on the page, e.g. the footer or description), then press the button below. You can remove it after verification:
claim.notFound: The code was not found yet. Make sure the page is saved and published.
claim.manualWait: Your request is saved. After we check it, the management link is sent to your email. Reference:
claim.verified: Verified! This is your private link and it is shown only once. Save it: anyone with this link can change the business's details:
claim.ownerIntro: Fill in only the fields you want to change.
claim.badKey: This link is not valid or its key is incomplete.
